overview_description.description: Miles People is a personal trainer platform. They connect fitness and sports trainers with trainees. They offer a digital coach by using an information matrix analysis for users and suggesting preferable fitness programmes, enabling users to avail themselves of virtual coaching networks between real trainers and trainees.
